What Is Oral Surgery?

Oral surgery is a specialized branch of dentistry focused on diagnosing and treating issues related to the teeth, gums, jaw, and facial structure. At Valencia Smile Expert, we offer a full range of oral surgery services to restore your oral health, relieve pain, and support future treatments like dental implants. Every procedure is performed with precision, using advanced imaging, gentle techniques, and sedation options to ensure your comfort.

children.html: Pre- and Post-Op Care for Oral Surgery

A smooth oral surgery experience depends on more than just the procedure itself—it also requires the right preparation and recovery care. At Valencia Smile Expert, we provide clear, personalized instructions to help you feel confident and supported every step of the way.
Before Your Procedure:

items.text: Follow fasting instructions if sedation is planned
Pause certain medications only if advised by Dr. Moezzi
Arrange for someone to drive you home if sedation will be used
Avoid smoking and alcohol for at least 24 hours prior
Maintain good oral hygiene to reduce infection risk

children.html: After Your Procedure:

items.text: Rest and limit physical activity for the first 24–48 hours
Eat soft, cool foods like yogurt, smoothies, and soup
Avoid drinking through a straw, smoking, or spitting forcefully
Use ice packs and prescribed medications to manage swelling and discomfort
Keep the surgical area clean with gentle brushing and saltwater rinses

children.html: Oral Surgery FAQs

Most oral surgeries are performed under local anesthesia, and we offer sedation options for added comfort. You may experience mild soreness afterward, but most patients report less discomfort than expected.

items.title: How long is recovery after oral surgery?

children.html: Initial recovery usually takes 2–5 days, depending on the procedure. Complete healing—especially for implants or bone grafts—can take several weeks to a few months.

items.title: What can I eat after oral surgery?

children.html: Stick to soft foods like smoothies, mashed potatoes, yogurt, soup, and scrambled eggs for the first few days. Avoid crunchy, spicy, or hot foods until cleared by our team.

items.title: How much does oral surgery cost?

children.html: Costs vary by procedure and insurance coverage. We provide transparent pricing and offer financing options to make treatment accessible.

items.title: Do you offer sedation for anxious patients?

children.html: Yes. We offer nitrous oxide and oral sedation to help you stay calm and comfortable throughout your procedure.

items.title: When should wisdom teeth be removed?

children.html: Wisdom teeth are often removed between ages 17–25, especially if they’re impacted, misaligned, or causing pain. Early removal can help prevent future complications.

items.title: How do I know if I need oral surgery?

children.html: If you’re dealing with persistent tooth pain, swelling, jaw discomfort, or preparing for implants, oral surgery might be necessary. Learn more about common surgical dental procedures and when they’re recommended from this Mayo Clinic overview on oral surgery.

items.title: Can I get oral surgery if I have a medical condition?

children.html: Many patients with medical conditions can safely undergo oral surgery. Dr. Moezzi will review your full health history to ensure any necessary precautions are taken.
